newsitem.title: CANADA: BCE Mobile issues C$150 mln debentures.
newsitem.headline: BCE Mobile issues C$150 mln debentures.

text.p: BCE Mobile Communications Inc said on Monday that its subsidiary Bell Mobility Cellular Inc arranged the private placement in Canada of C$150 million of senior unsecured debentures.
The Series E issue, due January 2007, carries a coupon of 7.30 percent to yield 7.304 percent. The issue is expected to close in January, the company said.

Proceeds will be used mainly for the company's capital expenditure program relating to the expansion of its analog cellular network and to the roll-out of its digital network, including initial investments in personal communications services (PCS).
The issue was placed with a group of major Canadian and U.S. institutional investors by RBC Dominion Securities Inc, CIBC Wood Gund Securities Inc and Scotia Capital Markets, acting as agents.
